heading: ### 9.144 CCO-0b：内部参照・canonical／hash scratch・追加workの調査

sites.obligation: input remains in the child until normalize helper and checkCommand have returned
prepared result is retained in the managed lease during check, then child.q during expected
raw-reservation is a lease flag; it does not replace the internal raw object
raw last use is command(q); observer conservatively holds it until makeCommand returns, without proving original GC liveness
schema result is live through wireIntent and the return
rest creates a distinct root which shares nested payload with schema result
wrapper and shallow command copy survive while canonical/hash consumes them
recursive active set and encode frames retain input ancestors
key array, map result of encoded field strings and join result
array map result and join output overlap at join return
native crypto allocation/work remains opaque; update bytes are observed
recursive descriptor copies, output graph and canonical validation
Object.values arrays and recursive freeze frames are not covered by managed ticks
explicit separate buffers exist from claim until reclaim
weak keys do not bound values while external claim/window handles remain live
child, identity, lease, retired, trace and diagnostic graph are not a fixed 16-ref table
each child retains separate expected/builder cores and a separate context until reclaim
zero and release work survives failure; it is not refunded
two actual character reads per successful compared byte
client seal performs a further byte comparison; not replaced by a digest
